title: 第9章 看了我的脸就是我的人
slug: 学霸女神超给力全本免费-学霸女神超给力最新章节列表
content_zh:
在场的学生，一个个全都愣住了。
“韩主任，可是……”
一个同学想说什么，却被另外一个同学给拉住了，两人交换了个眼色，最终还是什么都没说。
“今天的检查就到这里，大家都回教室，准备放学。”韩军栋说道，“今天晚上检查小组的所有成员，明天一早到我办公室一趟，一个都不准少，如果缺了谁……”
剩下的话根本不用说。
纪律检查小组的人先走了。
韩军栋盯着贺御翔和韩露露，咬牙问道：“你们两个，到底怎么回事！”
“韩主任，是她给我发短信约我来的……”
“我没有，我……”
“啪！”
韩露露话还没说完呢，就被韩军栋狠狠地甩了一巴掌。
韩露露都懵了，完全不敢置信地看着韩军栋。
这是她爸爸，第一次打她！
韩露露想死的心都有。
桃林碑那边终于安静下来，云画松了口气，却不敢立刻出去，谁知道他们有没有走远。
如果被发现了，就前功尽弃了。
此刻，背后一直靠近她的男人，也动了动，云画只觉得自己全身都是汗。
她攥紧了拳头，却还是不敢动。
她还不知道这人是干嘛的，为什么会躲在这里。现在别人都走了，就剩下她，万一……万一他要对她做点什么，可怎么办？
云画死死地咬着牙！

不，绝不，她绝对不会让自己再重复上辈子的命运！
这个男人要是真敢对她做什么的话，她一定宁愿鱼死网破，也不会让他得逞！
“人都走光了，还不出去？”男人的声音低沉沙哑中带着戏谑。
云画咬着唇，猫着腰试探着往前走了一步。
感觉背后的人并没有什么动作，云画飞快地往前跑了几步。
紧接着她立刻回头，想要看看对方到底是谁！
可对方的动作更太快，云画只看到一道人影闪过，对方就已经到了假山石的侧面。
她完全看不到他的脸，但能看到他穿着一身黑色的紧身衣服，微微侧头，棱角分明的侧脸，好看得让云画无法抑制自己的心跳！
“你到底是谁！”云画咬牙问道。
男人轻轻地笑了一下，阴影之中看不清楚他的五官，但他周身那种冷冽的气质，却让人根本无法忽略。
他的声音不再像刚才在石缝中两人距离非常近时的那般低沉，十分悦耳，如优雅的大提琴一般。
“小丫头，别那么好奇。我的脸，可不是随便谁都可以看的。”男人的声音中带着浅淡的笑意，“若是看了我的脸，那你可就是我的人了。怎么样，还看不看？”
“不看！”
云画几乎是没有任何犹豫地说道，她更是直接转身，用实际行动表明了她才不稀罕看他的脸！
开玩笑，已经死过一次的云画比谁都清楚，好奇害死猫的道理！
她早就不是真正天真烂漫的初二少女，跟好奇心比起来，她更在乎自己的命，更不想随便卷入什么麻烦之中！

content_en:
All the students present were stunned.
"Director Han, but..."
One classmate wanted to say something, but was stopped by another classmate. The two exchanged glances, but ultimately said nothing.
"That's it for today's inspection. Everyone should go back to the classroom and get ready for school." Han Jundong said, "All members of the inspection team tonight will come to my office early tomorrow morning. No one is missing. If anyone is missing..."
There is no need to say the rest.
The people from the disciplinary inspection team left first.
Han Jundong stared at He Yuxiang and Han Lulu, gritted his teeth and asked, "What's going on with you two!"
"Director Han, she sent me a text message to invite me to come..."
"I didn't, I..."
"Crack!"
Before Han Lulu could finish her words, she was slapped hard by Han Jundong.
Han Lulu was stunned and looked at Han Jundong in complete disbelief.
This is the first time her father has hit her!
Han Lulu wanted to die.
The Taolin Monument finally became quiet. Yun Hua breathed a sigh of relief, but he didn't dare to go out immediately. Who knew if they had gone far.
If discovered, all previous efforts will be wasted.
At this moment, the man who had been close to her behind her also moved, and Yun Hua felt that his whole body was covered in sweat.
She clenched her fists, but still didn't dare to move.
She still doesn't know what this person does and why he is hiding here. Now that everyone else is gone, she is the only one left. What if... what if he wants to do something to her?
Yun Hua gritted his teeth!
No, never, she would never let herself repeat the fate of her previous life!
If this man really dared to do anything to her, she would rather die than let him succeed!
"Everyone is gone, why don't you go out?" The man's voice was low and hoarse with a hint of joking.
Yun Hua bit his lip, bent his waist and took a tentative step forward.
Feeling that the person behind him didn't move much, Yun Hua quickly ran forward a few steps.
Then she immediately turned back, wanting to see who the other party was!
But the other party's movements were too fast. Yun Hua only saw a figure flash past, and the other party had already reached the side of the rockery.
She couldn't see his face at all, but she could see that he was wearing tight black clothes, his head tilted slightly, and his angular profile was so beautiful that Yun Hua couldn't suppress his heartbeat!
"Who are you!" Yun Hua gritted his teeth and asked.
The man smiled softly. His facial features could not be clearly seen in the shadow, but the cold temperament around him was impossible to ignore.
His voice is no longer as deep as it was when the two were very close to each other in the crevices of the rocks. It is very sweet, like an elegant cello.
"Little girl, don't be so curious. My face can't be seen by just anyone." There was a faint smile in the man's voice, "If you see my face, then you are mine. What do you think, don't you want to see it?"
"Don't look!"
Yun Hua said almost without any hesitation, and she turned around directly, showing with practical actions that she didn't care to look at his face!
Just kidding, Yun Hua, who has died once, knows better than anyone else why curiosity kills cats!
She is no longer a truly innocent and innocent girl in the second grade of junior high school. Compared with her curiosity, she cares more about her own life and does not want to get involved in any trouble!
If you like the goddess of academic tyranny, she’s so awesome. Please give her a thumbs up.
